summary: School district urges preservation of E-Rate program and rejection of proposals to sunset or reduce its funding, emphasizing the program's critical role in providing reliable broadband infrastructure for modern public education.

claims.argument: E-Rate support is essential for maintaining modern network infrastructure and connectivity in schools
claims.evidence_quote: Noxon School District 10 A.K.A. Noxon Public Schools has received $76,703 in committed federal E-Rate support over funding years 2021–2025 — an average of roughly $15,341 a year toward the connections our students depend on.
